Raw pcaps were not retained; these are the prop blobs extracted from those frames by ~/palace-corpus/tools/palace_walker.py::_store_asset (the known-good Python parser), together with the exact TCP payload length of the packet that carried each frame, recovered from ~/palace-corpus/pcap_extract/animanic_pass2_dump.txt and animanic_pass3_dump.txt.
how_to_read: Each sAst frame arrives as one block (blockNumber == 0, blockCount == 1).
Frame on the wire = 12-byte header (opcode,length,refNum) + payload.
payload = AssetSend header (24 B) + AssetDescriptor (40 B) + blockSize data + padding.
tcp_payload_len - 12 == 64 + asset_size, i.e. padding == 0, for every entry below.
The descriptor name arrived empty on this server, hence palace_walker's '_unnamed' file names.
